howAnApprovalTakesEffect: applyPilotApproval will only promote an item whose reviewStatus is 'reviewed' AND whose integrationStatus is 'integrated', that has no open correction against it, and that does not depend on audio nobody has listened to. So a record here is the last step, not the first: the challenge, review and integration records have to exist first. Claude drafts the integration record and a self-labelled challenge record; the review decision is the parent's alone.
